content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ACTREC Attendant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Attendant. This is a contract-based position at ACTREC.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Attendant post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is H.S.C. pass from a recognized board. Experience in a hospital or critical care area is preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Attendant post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Attendant post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Attendant position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Attendant position ranges from ₹21,510 to ₹25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: This is a Walk-in recruitment. Interested candidates need to attend the interview with all required documents at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q7. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 01 September 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview venue is at 2nd floor, Meeting Room no-210 CCE, TMC-ACTREC, Sec-22, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai- 410210.

faq.question: Q9. What documents do I need to carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You need to carry your Bio-data, recent passport size photograph, scanned copies of Aadhaar Card, PAN CARD, and ORIGINAL and Self Attested copies of qualification mark sheets, certificates, and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.
